name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-iii-doga-and-unei
title: Final Fantasy III - Doga and Unei
description:
(Also known as "Let Me Know The Truth")

A cover of Let Me Know The Truth from Final Fantasy III on the Famicom, one of my favorites from this OST!
This uses all vanilla instruments and was made for a compo a year or so ago, but I haven't been able to get around to uploading it until now.
